description: This file defines a functional interface called ReconnectListener in the package org.eclipse.hono.client. It is used to notify when a connection to a Hono service has been re-established after being lost. The interface has a generic type parameter T and a single method onReconnect that is invoked upon reconnection.

classes.name: ReconnectListener
classes.description: A functional interface for listening to reconnection events to a Hono service, with a generic type parameter T representing the connection type.

methods.name: onReconnect
methods.description: Method invoked after the connection to a Hono service has been re-established. Takes a client of type T as a parameter.
